# Emulators: large archives, one per system and architecture, often 7z.

== mgba-emu/mgba kind=app topics=emulator,gba
mGBA-0.10.3-win64.7z 10000000
mGBA-0.10.3-win64.zip 10000000
mGBA-0.10.3-win32.7z 9000000
mGBA-0.10.3-win32.zip 9000000

-> all: mGBA-0.10.3-win64.7z
# win64 states x64 only because no other architecture is named; the shorter .7z

== libretro/RetroArch kind=app topics=emulator,libretro
RetroArch.7z 150000000
RetroArch_cores.7z 450000000
RetroArch-Win64-setup.exe 130000000
RetroArch-Win32-setup.exe 120000000
-> x64: RetroArch-Win64-setup.exe
# On arm64 the archive that names no architecture is native, which ranks ahead of
# the x64 setup program that runs under emulation.
-> arm64: RetroArch.7z
